_comment: Firmware refusal texts the CLI shows or matches on, copied from benchpod-firmware main (897f057). format is the C string literal exactly as it appears in the source (adjacent literals joined, escapes kept); example is one rendering of it. The CLI tests check every example against its format, that the CLI shows or classifies it as intended, and, when a benchpod-firmware checkout is available (CI checks it out; locally the sibling directory), that each format is still in its source file, so a firmware wording change fails here. tiers pins cmd_tier.c entries for commands the CLI sends.

refusals.format: locked: %s needs the cloud or the USB console
refusals.example: locked: cloud_set needs the cloud or the USB console

refusals.format: busy: a cloud job holds this pod (%s, %lu s left)
refusals.example: busy: a cloud job holds this pod (ci-run-42, 37 s left)

refusals.format: forbidden: %s needs an organization owner or admin
refusals.example: forbidden: ota_begin needs an organization owner or admin
busy

refusals.format: busy: a capture, upload or update is using the PSRAM bus; try again when it ends
refusals.example: busy: a capture, upload or update is using the PSRAM bus; try again when it ends

refusals.format: swd busy: an SPI session is using the engine ({\"cmd\":\"spi_stop\"})
refusals.example: swd busy: an SPI session is using the engine ({"cmd":"spi_stop"})
swd busy
uart busy
unknown cmd
spi busy: send spi_stop first

refusals.format: swd or spi busy: end the SWD session first
refusals.example: swd or spi busy: end the SWD session first
unknown target

refusals.format: busy: %s update from %s is in progress
refusals.example: busy: firmware update from the cloud is in progress
